shared_elements: shallow relief carving on stone surface
radiating or linear elements extending from a central area
justification: Both surfaces present a prominent circular disc in low relief as a focal element, and both use simplified, schematic rather than naturalistic forms. However, A depicts a large frontal anthropomorphic statue with a head, torso, arms and a suite of small ornaments including a ring on the back, while B shows a central boss with a small figure inside it from which many straight lines radiate outward across the whole field; the compositional logic (standing body versus radial star/sun-like scheme) is quite different, and the shared disc is too universal a motif to indicate a common tradition.
